function.name: set_ac_state
function.description: Set the state of the air conditioner by adjusting the temperature, mode, fan speed, and fan position to achieve the desired comfort level. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

temperature.description: Desired temperature setting for the air conditioner in degrees Celsius.

fan_speed.description: Fan speed level from 1 to 5, where 1 is the lowest speed and 5 is the highest.

fan_position.description: Fan position level from 1 to 5, where 1 is the lowest and 5 is the highest.

function.name: get_ac_state
function.description: Fetch the current operational state of the air conditioner, including mode, temperature settings, and power status. If 'unit_id' is not provided, the default air conditioner unit will be queried. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

unit_id.description: The unique identifier of the air conditioner unit. If omitted, the system will fetch the state of the default AC unit.

include_diagnostics.description: Whether to include diagnostic information in the response.

message.content:
I’m a conversational AI that can help you with a variety of tasks—especially anything related to your smart home. Here’s a quick rundown of what I can do:

| What I can do | How it works |
|---------------|--------------|
| **Control your air conditioner** | I can set the temperature, mode (cool, heat, dry, fan, auto), fan speed, and fan position. I’ll call the `set_ac_state` function to send those commands to your AC unit. |
| **Check the current AC status** | I can fetch the current mode, temperature, power status, and even diagnostic info if you need it. I’ll use the `get_ac_state` function for that. |
| **Answer general questions** | From weather forecasts to cooking tips, I can provide information, explanations, or recommendations. |
| **Help with troubleshooting** | If your AC isn’t working right, I can walk you through common fixes or suggest when to call a technician. |
| **Set reminders or schedules** | I can help you remember to adjust the AC before you leave or set up a routine (e.g., “cool down to 22 °C at 7 pm”). |
| **Provide energy‑saving tips** | I can suggest optimal temperature settings, fan speeds, or modes to keep your home comfortable while saving electricity. |

If you’d like to try controlling your AC right now, just let me know the desired temperature, mode, fan speed, and fan position, and I’ll take care of the rest!
